reviews.text:
We have been looking for the right place to groom our dog for the past two years, and this year we finally found the perfect place for us!

From the very beginning, we were impressed by how kind, caring, and responsible Klaudia is. Most importantly, our dog feels completely comfortable there. It’s actually the first grooming place where she is happy to go back! She feels good when we bring her in, and she is still happy and relaxed when we come to pick her up.

For us, this says everything. It’s such a relief to know that our dog is in good hands and genuinely enjoys being there. We are so happy we found this place and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy groomer. ❤️🐾
My dog loves her visits to this place. Klaudia is extremely sweet with her. Our experience with the grooming service has been amazing. We really recommend it.

Complete lack of expertise in the case of slightly more energetic small dogs, they prefer to tie the dog up so that there is no task or work for him. We found our dog tied up, he was afraid of the trainer and was shaking for 2 days. Your dog cannot tell you what happened to him.

Fantastic people, very kind to all dogs and owners. Our dog loves going here, the grooming is 5/5 and they also offer dog massage. We really love this daycare, I highly recommend it to all dog owners.
Super nice and attentive team, my dog ​​loves coming here. Thank you on behalf of Ludi. 🐶 …
Good job, good location, great help with moving the dogs 🤩 …
Thank you very much for the very positive review! ♥️
The daycare is great, the boarding house is great too :) It's like entrusting our dog to a family member. Thank you very much here too!
Every time I leave my dog ​​here for a few hours, I know they will take care of him and he will play for the day!
They provide professional service in every way. I wouldn't take my dog ​​anywhere else. Thank you Peti for always being so kind 🥰 …

They are very reliable and kind.
+ They constantly post videos on their instastory so you can check how your dog is doing :)

I am very satisfied with DobDog, my dog ​​always comes home exhausted and ready to sleep. All the trainers are extremely qualified, and they treat even problem dogs patiently and efficiently. In addition to the daycare service, I can only recommend the dog school, dog grooming and dog massage. It is clear that everyone works here with their heart and soul. 🤗
We've taken our dog there a few times, he loves going, and we're also reassured that he's in a good place. +We just see him running away from the camera sometimes 😁 …
We love it with my dog ​​Rétes, he is a very loving little company, even his mustache is shiny after the cosmetics :) he absolutely loves daycare! he is so grumpy when he can't go :)

The place is good, but the trainers don't know what to do with active dogs

UPDATE:
For some reason it won't let me reply to a reply, so I won't do it in the most formal way, but this is how I can respond to the place's reply:

Of course, you are mostly right in what you wrote.
Loki was the one you are trying to write these things about.
Only 1 trainer didn't like him, and then all this happened because of him. If he were as bad and disobedient as you argue, he wouldn't have sat in the corner all day after your teasing, longingly watching to see if he could play, as he did in the aforementioned videos! A "bad" dog doesn't understand this, he wouldn't have left.
No, he didn't hurt anyone, he played with the other dogs the same way, and no one hurt him either.
Interesting, did he fully understand that there was a "problem" with him, and did you sit there by yourself?
I think then it would have been exactly what you wrote about the cases you described.
Most of the dogs go there to be tired, he can come to work with that much strength, because then he can lie down and sit there if he needs to. We saw all the videos you shared and anyone could see it, he didn't push it any further than the other dogs. He loved being there, playing with the others, he just had a good time.
The long-haired girl is very nice, she never complained…
If you think everything is going well like this and you are right, okay, then the people who go there will confirm it anyway.

Great dog daycare. We really like taking him there because we know he is in good hands, he plays with a lot of dogs and, most importantly, our dog loves it too. From an owner's point of view, it is also a special pleasure that they are open from 7:00 to 19:00, so we can easily take him before work and pick him up after work. Unfortunately, in many places, daycares start at that time, which is already working time for many people. We can really only recommend it to everyone. Oh, and there is a regular video of them, so you can see how they play or rest😊
